reporter_statement:
I work with the procurement team. In early March I was told by a colleague that PERSON_1 had asked for ORG_2's technical score to be raised before the committee met.
After the contract was signed I noticed two payments of $18,500 to ORG_3 for 'consulting'. I had never heard of ORG_3 and there was no consulting agreement that I could find.
I believe ORG_3 is connected to PERSON_1's husband, PERSON_3, but I have no documents that show this.

documents.text:

documents.title: RE: ORG_2 technical score
documents.text: PERSON_5 — please update the technical score for ORG_2 from 61 to 78 before the sheet goes to PERSON_4 on Friday. The committee already agreed verbally, so no need to recirculate. Thanks, PERSON_1

documents.title: Evaluation committee minutes — infusion pumps
documents.text: Meeting held 10 March 2026. Present: PERSON_1 (chair), PERSON_5, PERSON_6. Final technical scores: ORG_2 78, ORG_4 74. Price scores were taken from the bid summary without change. Recommendation: award the infusion pump contract (est. value $1.2M) to ORG_2. The committee notes no conflicts of interest were declared. Approved for award: PERSON_4, Chief Financial Officer, 14 March 2026.
